Light Space Architecture Office is a small, craft-based, contemporary, architecture firm located in San Francisco seeking a talented and motivated designer to grow with us. Our work is focused on buildings that express clarity from concept to detail. We value innovation, sustainability, building context, and engage deeply with our clients, builders, and consultants to arrive at practical and inspiring solutions.
We believe the health and success of our firm is directly related to the growth, development and happiness of our employees as design professionals. As such, we strive to offer an environment in which the creative contributions of all our team members are encouraged and supported from the conception through completion. We invite our employees to contribute to all phases of our work including schematic design.
All our employees receive highly competitive salaries, as well as health and retirement benefits. Our office is an open, light filled space conveniently located in downtown San Francisco about a 3-minute walk from the Montgomery BART station.
